symptom: Every app-to-worker relay frame awaited a database access read, adding about 240 ms to each cloud request round trip (file reads, Git, terminal input, prompts).
rule: Authority for hot frames is a bounded, revision-fenced window anchored before the read: security events and source revalidation clear it at once, it never renews by forwarding, it honors the earliest session or source expiry, and a newly admitted client forces a fresh read (principles 4, 9, 11).
